title: Gate 1 sequential multi-AI queue implementation
purpose: Implement the already accepted G1-DESIGN-V6 R5 as a GitHub-authoritative sequential queue above unchanged Gate 0, with human Codespace start/grant, deterministic election, fail-closed recovery and no repository-write jobs or parallel execution.

ownership.rule: CI/Ops must not author or weaken independent QA files. QA must not repair implementation files. Every implementation correction requires a complete QA rerun on the corrected exact head.

invariants: GitHub is authoritative for request discovery, session state, election, recovery and terminal state.
Every Gate 0 request is immutable and bound to its exact source comment, repository, origin and target SHA.
Exactly one non-terminal job may exist in a session; queue election is deterministic by immutable request identity.
A digest with durable JOB_STARTED is never automatically replayed after crash or ambiguity.
Request-author authority, source-comment immutability, suspension state and target SHA are reread immediately before Gate 0 invocation.
Gate 0 is invoked only through its four-operation allowlist and remains unchanged.
No arbitrary shell or request-supplied argv is exposed.
Gate 2 fan-in, Gate 3 repository write jobs and Gate 4 parallel execution remain HOLD.
Merge, release, promotion and governor decisions remain human/governor boundaries.
requiredEvidence: Exact baseline, merge base, implementation head and changed-path inventory.
Syntax/import checks for every tools/ai_jobs module.
Independent tests/ai_jobs suite with zero skips.
Existing tests/codespace_evidence Gate 0 suite unchanged and green.
Adversarial coverage for duplicate/conflict, stale target, edited request, pagination instability, crash after JOB_STARTED, suspension, credential/permission failure and close race.
Proof that Gate 0 blobs and all product/Atlas/M2/Pages paths remain unchanged.
nonGoals: Product, Atlas, authoring, kit, learner-state or Pages changes.
Automatic merge, release, promotion or governor decision.
rollback: Close draft PR #161 without merge or revert/delete only the bounded OPS-WP-007 paths. Gate 0, product, Atlas, kits, Pages, workflows and learner state remain untouched. Durable GitHub evidence comments are append-only and are never rewritten or deleted.
